metadata.canonical_dispatch_evidence: Canonical scenarios are counted by a test-only AIEngineClient subclass that delegates to super().callGenericFunction(); shared dispatch admission, parameter checks, and Registry handlers remain active.

Selected-action resolution and schema validation were approximately 0.02-0.13 ms. Validator reuse is not justified by the current measurements.
